### 2026-10-06 — Today I opened up KiCAD and began working. I installed all of the necessary components to build Starbie and began working. I built the schematic (after spending forever trying to find key combinations

**1.32h**

Today I opened up KiCAD and began working. I installed all of the necessary components to build Starbie and began working. I built the schematic (after spending forever trying to find key combinations, use functions, and work with KiCAD) and imported the schematic into the PCB Editor. Unfortunately, I ran into some unexplained errors with the importing. My best guess is that I used the wrong part or messed up the schematic layout.
